articles.summary: OUTFRONT Media Inc. (NYSE: OUT) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.33 per share payable on December 31, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026. About OUTFRONT Media Inc. OUTFRONT is one of the largest and most trusted out-of-home media companies in the U.S., helping brands connect with audiences in the moments and environments that matter most. As OUTFRONT evolves, it's defining a new era of in-real-life (IRL) marketing, turning public spaces into platforms for creativity, connection, and cultural relevance. With a nationwide footprint across billboards, digital displays, transit systems, and other out-of-home formats, OUTFRONT turns creative into powerful real-world experiences. Its award-winning in-house creative agency, OUTFRONT STUDIOS, delivers standout storytelling, supported by advanced technology and data tools that can drive measurable impact. Contacts: Investors
articles.title: OUTFRONT Media Announces Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: Revenues of $511.1 million Operating income of $102.8 million Net income attributable to OUTFRONT Media Inc. of $64.8 million Adjusted OIBDA of $145.3 million AFFO attributable to OUTFRONT Media Inc. of $102.9 million Quarterly dividend of $0.33 per share, payable December 31, 2026 OUTFRONT Media Inc. (NYSE: OUT) today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. "Our third quarter revenues grew over 9% given broad strength across all aspects of our business, and resulted in healthy Adjusted OIBDA and AFFO growth," said Nick Brien, Chief Executive Officer of OUTFRONT Media. "We currently expect 2026 will be a double-digit revenue growth year, reflecting our focused execution and IRL's re-emergence as an integral part of advertisers' marketing campaigns."
